title: ESTHER
subtitle: the book where God never says a word

lines.say: [whispers] Selah... is it true there's a book in the Bible that never mentions God? Not even once?
cap: Selah... is there a book in the Bible

lines.say: [knowingly] Esther. Not once. And somehow... He's on every page.
[confused] How does THAT work?!
[storytelling] Persia. The biggest empire on earth. And a Jewish orphan named Esther, raised by her cousin Mordecai.
The king searched the whole empire for a new queen. And he chose Esther.
cap: The king searched the whole empire for a new {o:queen}.

lines.say: But Mordecai told her: keep your family a secret. Don't tell anyone you're Jewish.
[ominous] Then came Haman. The king's right-hand man. Everyone bowed when he walked by.
Everyone... except Mordecai.
[seething] [quietly] One man won't bow? Then his whole people will pay.
[ominous] Haman tricked the king into a law. On one day, every Jew in the empire would be wiped out.
cap: Haman tricked the king into a {r:law}.
On one day, every Jew in the empire

lines.say: [horrified] EVERY one?! But Esther's Jewish!
And nobody knew. So Mordecai begged her to go to the king.
cap: So Mordecai begged her to go to the {o:king}.

lines.say: [afraid] Anyone who walks in without being called dies. Unless the king holds out his golden scepter.
[urgent] [quietly] Don't think the palace will save you. Who knows... maybe you became queen for such a time as this.
cap: “Don't think the palace will save you.
Who knows... maybe you became queen

lines.say: [softly] Esther fasted three days. Then she said...
[resolute] I will go to the king. And if I perish... I perish.
[whispers] She's actually going in.
[building] She walked into the throne room... and the king held out the scepter.
cap: She walked into the throne room...
and the king held out the {g:scepter}.

lines.say: [relieved] PHEW!
[amused] Then things got strange. That night, the king couldn't sleep. So he had the royal records read to him.
cap: That night, the king couldn't sleep.
So he had the royal {o:records} read to him.

lines.say: And he found out Mordecai had once saved his life. And was never rewarded.
cap: And he found out Mordecai had once

lines.say: [thoughtful] Haman. What should be done for the man the king wants to honor?
cap: for the man the king wants to {g:honor}?”

lines.say: [smug] [delighted] Royal robes. The king's own horse. A parade through the city!
[deadpan] So the king made Haman lead Mordecai through the city. On the horse. Shouting his praises.
[laughing] NO WAY!
At her banquet, Esther finally told the king the truth. Haman's plan. And her people.
cap: At her banquet, Esther finally told the king

lines.say: [furious] Who is he? Where is the man who dared to do this?!
cap: Where is the man who {r:dared} to do this?!”

lines.say: [fierce] This wicked Haman!
Haman fell, on the very gallows he built for Mordecai. And Esther's people lived.
cap: Haman fell, on the very gallows

lines.say: [thinking] But... God never showed up.
[warmly] Didn't He? An orphan becomes queen. A king can't sleep. A forgotten favor. A scepter held out.
cap: An orphan becomes {g:queen}. A king can't {g:sleep}.

lines.say: [tenderly] Sometimes God doesn't announce Himself. He just arranges everything.
[softly] So even when I can't see Him... He's still working?
cap: So even when I can't see Him...

lines.say: [gently] Especially then.
